text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Customs (Duties) (Exemption for Officials of International Organisations) Order 2005.

3. Every Official of an Organisation is hereby exempted from the payment of customs and excise duties on any goods brought into Singapore as his personal baggage for the purpose of his attending to the preparations for its Meetings or his attending its Meetings.
